operatingModel.title: Operating Model
operatingModel.intro: How the Council runs: the principles it works by, who decides what, the processes it operates, who does what in each, the rhythm of the year, the interfaces inside and outside, and the measures that say whether it runs well.
operatingModel.illustrativeTitle: Seeded to show the design. Every row is replaced by the Strategy Office before use.
operatingModel.readerNote: The Strategy Office and the Super Admin keep this page current.

principles.title: Operating principles
principles.hint: Five to seven statements the Council holds itself to, each with the reason behind it.
principles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No principles} one {# principle} other {# principles}}
principles.emptyHint: The Strategy Office writes the first principle here.
principles.max: Seven principles is the ceiling; edit or remove one first.
principles.deleteConfirm: Remove this principle? This cannot be undone.

governance.title: Governance and decision rights
governance.hint: The bodies that decide, laid out from the Council down, with the way decisions flow between them. Open a body for its decisions, members and escalation path.
governance.noEscalation: Final authority; nothing escalates beyond this body.
governance.emptyHint: The Council Strategy governance table and the Operating Model bodies feed this map.

processes.title: Process landscape
processes.hint: The eight core processes in the order the value flows. Each card opens the process on the Processes page with its Level 1 processes, procedures and SOPs.
processes.level1: {count, plural, =0 {No Level 1 processes} one {# Level 1 process} other {# Level 1 processes}}
processes.procedures: {count, plural, =0 {no procedures} one {# procedure} other {# procedures}}
processes.emptyHint: The process architecture is written on the Processes page.

raci.title: RACI matrix
raci.hint: Level 1 processes against the units. One unit is accountable for each process; the others are responsible, consulted or informed.
raci.gridAria: RACI matrix of Level 1 processes by unit
raci.keyboard: Arrow keys move between cells. Enter or Space changes the role: blank, R, A, C, I. Delete clears the cell.
raci.accountableExists: {unit} is already accountable for this process. A process has exactly one A.
raci.failed: The cell could not be saved.
raci.count: {count, plural, =0 {No processes} one {# process} other {# processes}} across {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
raci.emptyHint: Clear a filter to see the matrix again.

calendar.title: Planning and reporting calendar
calendar.hint: The year as a ring: strategy review windows, the budget cycle, statistical releases, NDS3 reviews, Council meetings, report deadlines and the Doha Data Forum. Hover for what is due, click to open the item.
calendar.eventsInYear: {count, plural, =0 {No events} one {# event} other {# events}} in {year}
calendar.monthAria: {month}: {count, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}}
calendar.listCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing due} one {# item due} other {# items due}}
calendar.emptyHint: Add the first event, or move to another year.

dialog.linkedHint: A process code such as P4.3, a report type code, or the id of a release.
dialog.invalidDate: The end date is before the start date.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.hint: What the Council gives and receives: the external entities it works with, and the flows between its own units.

external.title: External interfaces
external.hint: Entities from the register, with what NPC provides and receives, the focal points on both sides, the legal basis and the cadence.
external.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entities} one {# entity} other {# entities}}
external.emptyHint: The Strategy Office adds entities from the register here.

internal.title: Internal interfaces
internal.hint: Unit to unit. The matrix counts the flows each unit gives (rows) to each unit (columns); the chord draws the same flows as ribbons. Click a unit to see everything it gives and needs.
internal.cellAria: {from} to {to}: {count, plural, =0 {no flows} one {# flow} other {# flows}}
internal.chordHint: Hover a unit to light its flows; click it to filter the list.
internal.gives: {count, plural, =0 {gives nothing} one {gives # flow} other {gives # flows}}
internal.receives: {count, plural, =0 {receives nothing} one {receives # flow} other {receives # flows}}
internal.count: {count, plural, =0 {No interfaces} one {# interface} other {# interfaces}}
internal.emptyHint: Clear the unit filter, or add an interface.

propose.title: Propose a change to this interface
propose.hint: Describe what should change and why. The Strategy Office and the Super Admin are notified and decide.
propose.placeholder: For example: move the service level to three working days, or add a monthly reconciliation step.
propose.sent: Your proposal reached the Strategy Office.
propose.failed: The proposal could not be sent.

requests.title: Change requests
requests.hint: Proposals from unit heads. The Strategy Office approves or declines; the proposer is notified.
requests.count: {count, plural, =0 {No requests} one {# request} other {# requests}}
requests.emptyHint: Unit heads propose changes from any interface card.

kpis.title: Operational KPIs
kpis.hint: Five measures of how well the operating model runs. Two read live data; three are entered each month.

sourceTitle.auto: Read from the live data every time the page opens
sourceTitle.manual: Entered by the Strategy Office each month

dialog.title: Enter a value
dialog.hint: One value per month. Entering a month again replaces its value.
dialog.invalid: Enter a number and a month.

kpis.emptyHint: The five operational KPIs are defined by the Strategy Office.
